summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' catalogue — distinct from `polybus-ithaca`, the wise suitor Homer names among the last fighters in the hall.

story.text: Apollodorus names Polybus among the wooers assigned to Zacynthus, listed after Agenor and before Polydorus in Epitome 7.29 — and again at the end of the same list before Andromedes.
Homer's 'wise Polybus' who fought on with Agelaus and Eurynomus when the bow had slain the rest is the Ithaca-roll figure (`polybus-ithaca`), not necessarily this Zacynthian name in the Epitome.
